# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 46 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 39 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_046_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 46

**1** Jesus said: "From Adam to John the Baptist, among those born of women, no one is so superior to John the Baptist that his eyes should be downcast.

**2** Yet I have said: whoever among you becomes a little child will know the kingdom and will surpass John."

---

**Translation Notes (LOGOS):**
- "His eyes should be downcast" — an idiom for humility/shame; John need not lower his eyes before anyone
- "Becomes a little child" — the child-transformation again; the way to surpass John
- The paradox: the greatest of the born (John) is surpassed by the smallest who becomes a child

---
